packet.comment: Sent after the account creation delay timer expires when email validation is enabled.
Sent when the player clicks the "forgot password?" button on the main login dialog.
Sent when the player enters and submits the account name they want to recover. The server should generate and email a 7-digit PIN code.
Sent when the player enters the 7-digit PIN code received by email. The client enforces exactly 7 characters.
Sent when the player confirms a new password. For security, the client sends the account name, PIN, and new password together.
Sent with the player's captcha input. In server-checked mode the server validates the string; otherwise the server always accepts it.
Sent after 5 consecutive failures in server-checked mode. The server should respond with an updated captcha via CaptchaAgree.
Sent on use of title certificate. The client presents an input window; the player's chosen title string is sent here.
Sent instead of a chat line when the player types an #item or #npc command. Contains the direct pub ID of the item or NPC.
